title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Usage of Interest Amount on in laws and close friends 1961 views Q. I am a Neurosurgeon, starting a job in a private hospital, my salary is Rs 180000 per month. If all of this is taxed I land up paying 30-35% of the amount. I also do not have a house of my own nor do I have any ancestral property or any other source of income, my parents funded my education with difficulty and they no longer earn. If I buy a car and a house on loan which of course will have interest involved in it, I can get tax rebate, is it permissible? Also brief me on other halal sources where i can invest to save Income tax? My parents are elderly and their medical expenditure at times is exhorbitant, also as you know medical bills are too high nowadays, is it OK to have a medical insurance for them, and also for others? Regarding car insurance you have told that since govt insists, it is permisssible, is it ok to maintain a 1st party insurance all the time even after few years of purchase? 2397 views Q. I have bank loan and now I am paying my monthly installment to make an end. I am repentant not do it in future, is it biased my running prayer? 1751 views Q. Engineering Job in Bank 2573 views Q. I am an American new Muslim. I wanted to know about the new "Islamic insurance called Takaful. I wanted to know if this insurance halaal according to the shariah of Islam? It has been launched in Pakistan and in South Africa and in South Africa most of the ulema say that this "Islamic insurance" is the same as the insurance of the commercial banks because the element of gambling and riba are still present. what is your opinion on this very important matter? Please answer. 1941 views Q. Assalamualikum, I think this is haraam but can you please verify it for me? A person sets up a savings account from which he recieves a certain amount of interest. The person then takes out a loan to buy a car, house, etc. and uses the interest he had earned from the savings account to pay off the interest on the loan. 2055 views Q. Is the Government-Backed Insurance Scheme for Artisans Permissible in Islam? 2535 views Q. Please help us to find the right way in our life. I am a software engineer working for a software company. The focus of our software company is banking field and most of the clients are banks. The problem I am facing now is that the project that I am working is for banking software and the bank that I am working is not Islamic bank. The software that I develop or involved is used by the Bank to open account on-line through internet,applying on-line application for credit card, to view the Interest rates on internet for checking account, saving account and fixed deposits, etc.. I ask you to guide me whether doing work for a bank is haram (unlawful) even though I am not directly working for the bank and salary is given by my company, not the Bank. 2274 views Q. I am working in travel agency as accountant and agency owners are muslims and they are holding overdaraft account in bank and bank charge interest on overdaraft. and as a accountant i have to maintain bank account and have to do bank reconceliation and have to pass interest entries in computer. doing so is halal or haram. 1812 views Q. Helping the elders in getting the interest 1496 views Q. Can interest money be used to help a friend who has taken home loan to purchase a home? 1974 views Q. Can i spend the bank interest amount to pay income tax? 2784 views Q. My que is i have interest money with me. can i purchase fazaail e aamal with this money and hand it over to my poor relative without any intention of reward. 1728 views Q. I am living in 3% muslim populated area in Rajasthan. Any Islamic Bank/islamic Financial institution is not available in whole area. I want to start a business with 75% Loan money by Bank.I have no other ulternate except to take interest based loan from Bank.The whole economy is interest based. I also consulted Ulema of Other countries on internet,they replied me to take advise of Indian Ulema. What is the Sharia rulings on such Loan and business? If it is completely forbidden, what is the ulternate? 2426 views Q. Use of interest money 4515 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 11155 Country: United Kingdom Title: Assalamualaikum 1-Is it permissible to use Intrest money to make a toilet in Relatives house? 2-Is it permissible to take Mortgage from bank to buy a house,In uk some Ulama say its permissible if a person hasn't got a house of his own? Question: Assalamualaikum 1-Is it permissible to use Intrest money to make a toilet in Relatives house? 2-Is it permissible to take Mortgage from bank to buy a house,In uk some Ulama say its permissible if a person hasn't got a house of his own? Answer ID: 11155 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 303/206=L/1430) It is not allowed to use it. It should be given in charity to the poor and needy. (2) Please, ask the Ulama in London to write it down and send it to us, then we shall reply you in-shaAllah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
